claims.statement: Tom Allen was captured at his saloon by the Franklin County officers and taken to the Four Courts on 1888-04-18.
claims.excerpt: repaired to Tom Allen’s saloon, where hey captured the ex-champion and escorted

claims.statement: The Globe-Democrat called Tom Allen the ex-champion.
claims.excerpt: where hey captured the ex-champion and escorted

claims.statement: Allen and the other men arrested left St. Louis by train on the evening of 1888-04-18 for a preliminary hearing at Union, Franklin County.
claims.excerpt: The sports left on the same ain, and will, im all probabt!lity, Waive jexamination

notes: Conflicts with 754, which says Allen was arrested as he was about to sit down to breakfast. The $500 bond printed here is for Kelly, Tucker and Esher, not Allen (Allen's bond is in 754). The travel line is partly a prediction ('will, in all probability, waive examination').
